name: Shoulder Wall Slide

instructions.description: Stand with your back against a wall and elbows bent to about ninety degrees.
Gently flatten the ribs and keep the head and upper back supported against the wall.
Slide the arms upward as far as you can without shrugging or arching the lower back.
Return slowly to the start position and repeat.

performanceMetrics.notes: Use controlled repetitions emphasizing quality of shoulder motion.

variationSuggestions.variationDescription: Perform the same pattern lying on the floor for more feedback.

commentsNotes: Do not force the wrists or elbows to stay on the wall if that causes compensation.
